in_marathi.name: Jaswanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Treasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaswanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaswanth is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Jas’ (wealth) and ‘Wanth’ (treasure). This name signifies being the Lord of Wealth or Treasure. It is also considered an auspicious name for a child as it symbolizes abundance and prosperity.
